name: Maelstrom Nexus

abilities.text: The first spell you cast each turn has cascade.

notes: "The first spell you cast each turn has cascade" is written as the cast trigger the granted ability IS (CR 702.85a), gated by `oncePerTurn` so it fires on the first spell you cast in a turn and no later one. `nth: 1` on the event is the same thing (spellsCastThisTurn is incremented before the trigger check) but renders worse; either way the format cannot attach an ability to a spell on the stack. Known engine shortfall: the core `cascade` op reads the mana value of the ability's SOURCE (Maelstrom Nexus, MV 5) rather than of the spell just cast.

problems: round trip 0.43 < 0.55: "The first spell you cast each turn has cascade." rendered as "whenever you casts spell, cascade. this ability triggers only once each turn"
